summary: Navajo Reservation lookout in the Chuska Mountains, San Juan County, NM; NHLR gives a 1936 build and an 81 ft Aermotor LS-40 with a 7x7 cab; FFLA lists it standing.

facts.design: Aermotor LS-40 tower with 7x7 metal cab (NHLR)

events.note: Built and put into service in 1936 as an 81 ft LS-40 Aermotor tower with a 7x7 metal cab, per NHLR
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register on July 20, 2002 as US 435, NM 10

evidence.supports: Elevation 9,179 ft in the Chuska Mountains; highest elevation station in the NM section of the reservation
evidence.quote: At 9,179’ in the Chuska Mountains, Washington Pass Lookout is the highest elevation station in the New Mexico section of the Navajo Reservation.

evidence.supports: Located in San Juan County, New Mexico
81 ft LS-40 Aermotor with 7x7 metal cab, built and put into service in 1936
evidence.quote: The 81’ LS-40 Aermotor tower with 7’x7’ metal cab was built and put into service in 1936.

evidence.supports: Administered by the Navajo Indian Reservation
Bureau of Indian Affairs is a cooperator
Listed as a standing tower with NHLR US 435, NM 10; coordinates 36.07810, -108.85839
evidence.quote: San Juan Washington Pass 36.07810 -108.85839 Tower Standing NHLR US 435, NM 10

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 36.085400, -108.852000 and FFLA gives 36.07810, -108.85839, about 1 km apart. Both are kept as published and the story does not choose one.

notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR entry and the FFLA New Mexico list give usable facts; no history, staffing, fire or fate record was found, so the story is thin. Brief record says Washington Pass and Tohnitsha share a register number; the sources give US 435 and US 434, so that conflict note looks wrong. Brief access 'permission' is not supported by a fetched page and was left out of facts. Search snippets (not fetched, not cited): a 2024 Navajo guide listing a Washington Pass lookout on the Chuska route, and Narbona Pass name history. A search-returned npgallery PDF was a Washington State (Chelan Butte) nomination and was not used.
